training/dual::DualEntryConfig.summary: Top-level entry config launching one dual-trunk training run through the shared backbone dataset, curriculum, and trainer machinery

fields.run_name: Optional suffix appended to the canonical run name; every run directory is named model_head_matching_loss with this label (or a timestamp) appended
fields.resume: Reuse this run directory when it already holds a completed run (complete.json marker stamped only at successful completion), rerunning inference only if it is missing; an unfinished run directory is deleted and restarted from scratch. Lets interrupted trials sweeps and seed sweeps continue without retraining finished units (distinct from training.resume, which continues one run mid-training from its last.pt and suppresses the delete)
fields.resume_from: Full path of an existing run directory to resume, pasted as-is; overrides run_name and logdir with the directory's own name and parent, bypassing the config-derived run naming so the resumed run cannot collide with or miss its original directory. Forces resume and training.resume, so a completed run is reused and an unfinished one continues from its saved trainer state instead of being deleted. Sweeps accept it too: paste the sweep folder or any run directory inside it, and the scheduler reconciles the planned trials and seeds against their complete.json markers, reusing complete runs, resuming unfinished ones from their checkpoints, and training missing runs (missing seeds included) from scratch. On terrabyte the pasted path must already exist on the cluster after translation; it is verified at submission and never uploaded. Cluster seed fan-outs still reject it
fields.model_name: Dual-family model key looked up in the dual registry; the registry holds only dual_resunet, so the field stays at its default and is not shown on the launch page (the trunk backbones are the architecture selection)
fields.gpu: Primary GPU device index on which a single run executes
fields.seed: Base random seed for a single training run, controlling weight init, shuffling, and augmentation
fields.seeds: List of seeds for a multi-seed sweep, one full run launched per seed and nested as seed<N> inside the base run directory; defaults to the standard five-seed set 0-4, empty falls back to the single seed field
fields.logdir: Base directory under which this run's output subdirectory and TensorBoard logs are written
fields.model_overrides: Dict of architecture-config field overrides applied to the dual model config before instantiation
fields.params_backbone: Trunk architecture of the full-input parameter branch, any backbone-zoo model key, applied to the model config before instantiation
fields.existence_backbone: Trunk architecture of the existence branch, any backbone-zoo model key, applied to the model config before instantiation
fields.params_input: Channel groups (pass, ifg, dem) the parameter trunk receives, resolved to concrete channel indices against the assembled dataset stack at build time; the dem group only carries a channel when input.use_dem is on
fields.existence_input: Channel groups (pass, ifg, dem) the existence trunk receives; defaults to the full stack (the standard full-full routing)
fields.params_overrides: Dict of config-field overrides applied to the parameter trunk's own architecture config class (structural fields forced by the dual model are rejected); trunk widths stay on model_overrides params_features
fields.existence_overrides: Dict of config-field overrides applied to the existence trunk's own architecture config class (structural fields forced by the dual model are rejected)
fields.paths: TrainingPathsConfig sub-config holding filesystem locations for the dataset, extracted parameters, and secondary-track labels
fields.training: TrainingQueueConfig sub-config bundling training-loop and queue settings (epochs, batch size, workers, AMP, EMA, resume, scheduler/warmup/clip knobs)
fields.pretrain: PretrainConfig sub-config for optional pre-training preflight (batch-size search, dataloader tuning, VRAM budget)
fields.curriculum: LossCurriculumConfig defining the two-stage warmup/complete loss schedule and its swap epoch; defaults to the physics-loss curriculum with hungarian param matching in both stages, the recommended pairing for the set-prediction existence gate
fields.geometry: GeometryConfig sub-config of raw SAR acquisition geometry defaults, resolved against the dataset's baselines table before training starts
fields.input: InputConfig sub-config selecting which channel groups feed the network, defaults to the full stack; use_interferograms must stay enabled because the existence trunk consumes exactly those channels
fields.normalization: NormalizationConfig sub-config controlling per-channel input/output normalization strategies and output clamping
fields.augmentation: AugmentationConfig sub-config setting horizontal/vertical flip, rot90, and additive-noise probabilities applied to training patches
fields.probe: LossScaleProbeConfig sub-config for the pre-training loss-scale probe that averages every loss term over a few batches and reports balanced weight suggestions, disabled by default
fields.overfit_check: OverfitCheckConfig sanity gate that memorizes a few examples before full training and aborts if the model cannot overfit them
fields.infer_after: Run the shared inference pipeline with the dual components automatically on the trained checkpoint once training completes
fields.infer_at_end: Hold all inference until every training job of the fan-out has finished, then run one inference job per completed run through the same GPU queue; keeps the GPUs saturated with training first, mutually exclusive with infer_after
fields.inference: InferenceConfig sub-config used to run inference automatically after training when infer_after or infer_at_end is set
fields.trials_enabled: Enable the multi-trial GPU sweep (DualTrainScheduler) that fans one training run per trial out across GPUs instead of launching a single run
fields.trials_mode: Sweep dimension the dual trial scheduler varies: the full backbone catalog (curriculum, warmup, presence, physics, pair, secondary, patch, input, context, reach, head, augmentation, normalization, ablation) plus the dual-specific routing mode (one run per trunk channel-group assignment under logdir/routing) and ratio mode (one run per arm-capacity split under logdir/ratio)
fields.warmup_losses: Named loss-term override presets: in trials_mode=curriculum applied to the curriculum warmup stage and crossed against every complete_losses preset (one run per pair); in trials_mode=warmup applied instead to the complete stage with curriculum disabled, one run per preset
fields.complete_losses: Named loss-term override presets applied to the curriculum complete stage, used only by trials_mode=curriculum where each preset is crossed against every warmup_losses preset (one run per pair)
fields.presence_trials: Named trials each setting use_active_normalization and presence_balance (both keys required per trial); default is the 2x2 matrix none/A/B/AB, swept with curriculum disabled and every trial repeated across the seeds list
fields.physics_trials: PhysicsTrialsConfig sub-config for the physics-loss sweep crossing every selected component with every candidate weight and curriculum state on top of the base config
fields.pair_trials: PairTrialsConfig sub-config for the loss-pair sweep pairing one fixed base component with each candidate second component and weight, curriculum disabled
fields.log_energy_trials: LogEnergyTrialsConfig sub-config for the log-energy weight sweep adding the term to the standard loss in both curriculum stages, one run per weight
fields.secondary_trials: SecondaryTrialsConfig sub-config for the secondary-track selection sweep (strategy, count, sampling seed)
fields.patch_trials: PatchTrialsConfig sub-config for the patch-size and stride sweep
fields.input_trials: Named input-channel presets (use_primary/use_secondaries/use_interferograms/use_dem) each scoped by a mandatory tracks key: all expands the secondary list to every track in the baselines table, reduced keeps the configured secondary selection; defaults cover the full grid of pass-amplitude-only, ifg-phase-only and the combined stack on both scopes
fields.context_trials: Rungs trained one run each, walking the spatial-context ladder at constant depth with the rung architecture and overrides applied to both trunks; every rung is a dict of label, backbone and model overrides (default four local_cnn rungs of ten blocks, RF 1/9/29/41 via block_kernels mixes of 3x3 and 1x1, widths 1277/848/502/426), and every backbone must exist in the registry
fields.reach_trials: ReachTrialsConfig sub-config for the size-matched architecture comparison at fixed reach with the rung architecture applied to both trunks, pairing a 33x33 local_cnn against a unet on a shared 32x32 patch at equal whole-model parameter count (both models built and counted at launch)
fields.head_trials: HeadMatchingTrialsConfig sub-config for the head-and-matching grid on one fixed trunk architecture applied to both trunks; the dual model only supports the set_pred head, so the sweep varies the parameter-matching strategy
fields.augmentation_trials: Named trials each mapping a label to an augmentation state (boolean): true trains with horizontal and vertical flips at probability 0.5 (rot90 and noise forced off), false trains with all augmentation probabilities at zero; default is the on/off pair, every trial repeated across the seeds list
fields.normalization_trials: NormalizationTrialsConfig sub-config for the cumulative normalization ladder walking pass amplitude, then ifg phase, then output amp, then output mu, then output sigma from their legacy-mode initial to their final strategies, one run per rung plus the all-legacy baseline

Empty places gpu_pool.json inside the trials directory for trials, or the base run directory for a multi-seed fan-out
fields.poll_interval_s: Seconds between successive polls of the run queue while waiting for GPUs or completed jobs

fields.params_features: Encoder feature widths of the parameter trunk used for every trial; defaults to the four-level parity ladder 48-96-184-352, sized so the two symmetric trunks together match the benchmark's size-matched single-trunk resunet budget
fields.existence_features: Encoder feature widths of the existence trunk used for every trial; defaults to the same four-level parity ladder 48-96-184-352

patch_sweep/general::PatchGridConfig.summary: Per-axis (azimuth, range) patch-length grids swept as a cross product for every selected dataset, spaced at the architecture's minimum admissible step
